title: CTLink: A Text-Prompted Segmentation Model for Linking Radiology Report Findings to 3D Chest CT Scans
abstract: arXiv:2611.31222v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Radiology reports describe findings in text only, without visually marking them on the scan, so readers cannot directly see which abnormality each reported finding refers to. We introduce CTLink, a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that segments findings described in a chest CT report. CTLink was trained on 4123 noncontrast chest CT scans with 9547 segmented report findings, including ReXGroundingCTv2, a newly annotated dataset of 1134 scans and 1895 findings with every instance of each finding segmented. On the 200 ReXGroundingCT validation scans, CTLink achieved a hit rate of 0.816, an instance F1 score of 0.456, and a mean Dice score of 0.400, compared with 0.533, 0.175, and 0.234 for VoxTell, a publicly available text-prompted segmentation model (P < .001 for all). On the test set of the MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding challenge, an ensemble of seven CTLink models achieved the highest hit rate (0.782) and instance F1 score (0.386) of al

translated_title: CTLink：一种将放射学报告中的检查发现与3D胸部CT扫描相关联的文本提示分割模型
translated_abstract: 放射学报告仅以文字形式描述检查发现，而不在扫描图像上进行可视化标注，因此读者无法直接看到报告中描述的每一项发现所对应的具体异常位置。我们提出了CTLink，这是一种基于文本提示的3D分割模型，能够对胸部CT报告中描述的检查发现进行分割。CTLink在4123例非增强胸部CT扫描及9547个经过分割标注的报告发现上训练，其中包括ReXGroundingCTv2——一个新标注的数据集，包含1134例扫描和1895个发现，且每个发现的每一处实例均被完整分割标注。在200例ReXGroundingCT验证扫描上，CTLink取得了0.816的命中率、0.456的实例F1分数和0.400的平均Dice分数，而公开可用的文本提示分割模型VoxTell的相应指标分别为0.533、0.175和0.234（P均<0.001）。在MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding挑战赛的测试集上，由七个CTLink模型组成的集成模型取得了所有方法中最高的命中率（0.782）和实例F1分数（0.386）。
tldr: 本文提出文本提示的3D分割模型CTLink，能将胸部CT放射报告中的文字性检查发现定位并分割为扫描中的具体病灶实例，并依托新标注数据集ReXGroundingCTv2训练，在验证集上显著优于现有模型，且在MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding挑战赛中取得最优成绩。
en_tdlr: CTLink is a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that grounds radiology report findings to their specific lesion instances in chest CT scans, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the ReXGroundingCT validation set and winning the MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding challenge.
